headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on Apar Advertisers IPO
sum: Apar Advertisers Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus before the SEBI for a book-built offer on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME platform for a fresh issue of 25,00,000 shares with an offer size of ₹18 crore+. Legacy Law Offices…
detail: Apar Advertisers Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus before the SEBI for a book-built offer on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME platform for a fresh issue of 25,00,000 shares with an offer size of ₹18 crore+. Legacy Law Offices advised Apar Advertisers as well as the Book Running Lead Manager, Pune E-Stock Broking Ltd, on this IPO. This also marks the BRLM’s first-ever IPO. The transaction was led by Naman Anand (Counsel), with support from Priya Kataria (Associate Partner), Meghna Shukla (Associate), and Pavitra Balgi (Associate).
